statement: ∀ (k : ℕ) (j : Fin (k+1)) (y : Fin k → ℝ), Continuous (fun r : ℝ => (j.insertNth r y : Fin (k+1) → ℝ))
proof:
intro k j y
apply continuous_pi
intro i
rcases j.eq_self_or_eq_succAbove i with rfl | ⟨a, rfl⟩
· simp only [Fin.insertNth_apply_same]
  exact continuous_id
· simpa only [Fin.insertNth_apply_succAbove] using (continuous_const : Continuous (fun _ : ℝ => y a))
